theorem mapped_localBase_factor (a : ℕ) (m s : Nodes a) (hsm : s ≠ m) : (LocalCharts.localBase a m s).map LocalIntegral.integralRing.subtype = C ((LocalIntegral.rhoUnit a m:LocalIntegral.integralRing):ℚ)* (C ((LocalIntegral.chartRatio a m s:LocalIntegral.integralRing):ℚ)*X)* (restPolynomial a m s).map LocalIntegral.integralRing.subtype

theorem indexed_crossing_base_content (a i : ℕ) (m s : Nodes a) (hsm : s ≠ m) (hv : padicValRat 2 (node a m-node a s) ≤ (i:ℤ)) : Content ((a:ℤ)+1-i) ((base (grid a) (node a s)).comp (C (node a m)+C ((2:ℚ)^(a+1))*X))

theorem actual_crossing_base_content (a u i x y : ℕ) (hx : x < 2^a) (hy : y < 2^a) (hi : i < u) (hu : u ≤ a) (hc : x.testBit i = y.testBit i) : Content ((a:ℤ)+1-i) (chart a (pole i) (base (grid a) (delta x y)))

theorem mapped_rest_product (a : ℕ) (m s : Nodes a) : (restPolynomial a m s).map LocalIntegral.integralRing.subtype = ∏ j ∈ (univ.erase m).erase s, (1+C ((LocalIntegral.chartRatio a m j:LocalIntegral.integralRing):ℚ)*X)
theorem actual_rest_weighted (a : ℕ) (m s : Nodes a) : WeightedPolynomial ((restPolynomial a m s).map LocalIntegral.integralRing.subtype)

theorem actual_completed_chart_unit (a u i x y : ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℕ) (hx : x < 2^a) (hy : y < 2^a) (hi : i < u) (hu : u ≤ a) (hc : x.testBit i = y.testBit i) : ∃ U : ℚ[X],WeightedPolynomial U ∧ U.coeff 0=1 ∧ chart a (pole i) (completed (grid a) u x y M) = C (firstJet a u i x y M)*X*U

theorem actual_first_ratio_integral (a u i x y : ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℕ) (hx : x < 2^a) (hy : y < 2^a) (hi : i < u) (hu : u ≤ a) (hc : x.testBit i = y.testBit i) : VBound 0 (firstJet a u i x y M/diagonalJet a u i M)

theorem terminal_fibonacci_bound (ms : List ℕ) (r : ℕ) (h : Feasible 0 (ms ++ [r])) : Nat.fib (2 * ms.length + 1) * r ≤ (ms ++ [r]).sum ∧ Nat.fib (2 * ms.length + 2) * r ≤ penalty (ms ++ [r])
theorem anchors_length (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℕ) : (anchors m u).length = u
theorem anchors_append (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℕ) : anchors m (u+1) = anchors m u ++ [m u]
theorem anchors_cons (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℕ) : anchors m (u+1) = m 0 :: anchors (fun j => m (j+1)) u
theorem anchors_mass (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℕ) : (anchors m u).sum = ∑ j ∈ range u, m j
theorem penalty_append_single (ms : List ℕ) (r : ℕ) : penalty (ms ++ [r]) = penalty ms + (ms.length+1)*r
theorem anchors_penalty (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℕ) : penalty (anchors m u) = ∑ j ∈ range u, (j+1)*m j
theorem head_penalty (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℕ) : penalty (anchors (fun j => m (j+1)) u) = ∑ j ∈ range (u+1), j*m j
theorem schedule_shift (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u i : ℕ) : schedule (u+1) (i+1) m = schedule u i (fun j => m (j+1))
theorem actual_schedule_feasible (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℕ) (hm : ∀ i < u, 0 ≤ schedule u i m) : Feasible 0 (anchors m u)
theorem actual_terminal_mass_bound (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℕ) (hm : ∀ i < u+1, 0 ≤ schedule (u+1) i m) : Nat.fib (2*u+1)*m u ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (u+1), m j
theorem actual_terminal_degree_cap (m : ℕ → ℕ) (u K L : ℕ) (hm : ∀ i < u+1, 0 ≤ schedule (u+1) i m) (hdegree : ∑ j ∈ range (u+1), m j ≤ K*L) : Nat.fib (2*u+1)*m u ≤ K*L

theorem selected_factor_ne_zero (u x y j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ mask u x y) : factor (delta x y) j ≠ 0
theorem correction_ne_zero (u x y : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : correction u x y m ≠ 0
theorem correction_degree_exact (u x y : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : (correction u x y m).natDegree = ∑ j ∈ mask u x y, m j
theorem diagonal_correction_degree (u x : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : (correction u x x m).natDegree = mass u m

theorem base_ne_zero (S : Finset ℚ) (d : ℚ) (h0 : 0 ∈ S) : base S d ≠ 0
theorem completed_diagonal_degree (S : Finset ℚ) (u x : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (h0 : 0 ∈ S) : (completed S u x x m).natDegree = S.card-1+mass u m

theorem actual_terminal_polynomial_budget (a u x K : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i < u+1, 0 ≤ schedule (u+1) i m) (hdegree : (completed (grid a) (u+1) x x m).natDegree ≤ (2*2^a-1)+K*2^a) : Nat.fib (2*u+1)*m u ≤ K*2^a
